[SWS_Pwm_20085]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00171
⌈The function Pwm_GetOutputState shall be configurable On/Off by the configura-
tion parameter: PwmGetOutputState {PWM_GET_OUTPUT_STATE_API}.
Due to real time constraint and setting of the PWM channel (project dependant), the
output state can be modified just after the call of the service Pwm_G
